name: Kustom Kulture
summary: Kustom Kulture , as an American subculture, emerged from mid-20th century hot rod and custom motorcycle scenes, especially in Southern California.
description: Kustom Kulture , as an American subculture, emerged from mid-20th century hot rod and custom motorcycle scenes, especially in Southern California. It combines vehicle modification with art, fashion, and related styles. It is often associated with do-it-yourself craftsmanship, custom paint, pinstriping, lowbrow art, and youth subcultures such as greasers, drag racers, and lowriders.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Individual expression, mechanical craftsmanship, DIY customization, a rebellious stance toward mass-produced uniformity
keyExamples: film imagery associated with 1950s–1970s car culture
